scene: A poor tailor's shop in a city. The walls are bare, and the room is humble and sparse. A small workbench sits by the window with a few scraps of cloth.
caption: "There once lived a poor tailor, who had a son called Aladdin."

scene: A dusty street in the city, lined with simple buildings. A group of small boys are gathered in a clear patch of ground.
action: Aladdin plays ball in the streets with the other boys.
caption: "A careless, idle boy who would do nothing but play ball all day long."

scene: The interior of the tailor's shop, now dimmer. Mustapha sits at his workbench, his face lined with worry and exhaustion.
caption: "This so grieved the father that he died."

scene: A simple home. Aladdin's mother sits weeping, a handkerchief to her face. Aladdin stands nearby, unmoved.
caption: "In spite of the mother's tears and prayers, Aladdin did not mend his ways."

scene: The same dusty street as before. Aladdin plays ball as usual. A stranger in dark robes approaches him from behind.
action: The stranger asks Aladdin his age and if he is the son of Mustapha.
caption: "A stranger asked him his age, and if he was not the son of Mustapha the tailor."

scene: The street. The magician, disguised as a wealthy traveller, embraces Aladdin warmly.
action: The magician falls on Aladdin's neck and kisses him.
caption: "The stranger fell on his neck and kissed him, saying, I am your uncle."

scene: The interior of Aladdin's home. Aladdin runs in breathlessly to tell his mother the news.
action: Aladdin speaks excitedly to his mother.
caption: "Aladdin ran home and told his mother of his newly found uncle."

scene: The home. Aladdin's mother looks doubtful, her brow furrowed with uncertainty.
caption: "Indeed, child, your father had a brother, but I always thought he was dead."

scene: The home, now set with a modest supper. Wine and fruit sit on the table. The magician enters, laden with provisions.
action: The magician enters carrying wine and fruit.
caption: "However, she prepared supper, and bade Aladdin seek his uncle, who came laden with wine and fruit."

scene: The home. The magician kneels and kisses the empty chair where Mustapha used to sit.
action: The magician falls down and kisses the place where Mustapha used to sit.
caption: "He presently fell down and kissed the place where Mustapha used to sit."

scene: The home. The magician sits at the table, speaking to Aladdin's mother with an air of explanation.
caption: "He bade Aladdin's mother not to be surprised at not having seen him before."

scene: The home. The magician turns to Aladdin, who stands sheepishly before him.
action: The magician asks Aladdin his trade.
caption: "He then turned to Aladdin, and asked him his trade."

scene: The home. Aladdin hangs his head in shame. His mother weeps.
action: Aladdin hangs his head; his mother bursts into tears.
caption: "At which the boy hung his head, while his mother burst into tears."

scene: The home. The magician stands, gesturing warmly toward Aladdin.
action: The magician offers to set Aladdin up in a shop.
caption: "He offered to take a shop for him and stock it with merchandise."

scene: The next day. A fine suit of clothes is laid out. Aladdin stands in the street wearing the new garment.
action: The magician leads Aladdin through the city.
caption: "Next day he bought Aladdin a fine suit of clothes and took him all over the city."

scene: The city streets at dusk. The magician walks Aladdin home through the bustling market.
action: The magician brings Aladdin home at nightfall.
caption: "He brought him home at nightfall to his mother, who was overjoyed."

scene: Beautiful gardens outside the city gates. Lush trees and flowering bushes line a winding path. A stone fountain gushes water in the centre.
action: The magician leads Aladdin into the gardens.
caption: "The next day the magician led Aladdin into some beautiful gardens."

scene: The gardens. Aladdin and the magician sit on a stone bench beside the fountain.
action: They sit down by the fountain.
caption: "They sat down by a fountain."

scene: The gardens. The magician pulls a cake from his girdle and breaks it in two.
action: The magician divides the cake between them.
caption: "The magician pulled a cake from his girdle, which he divided between them."

scene: A rocky path ascending toward distant mountains. The ground grows rougher and the air thinner.
action: They journey onward toward the mountains.
caption: "They then journeyed onward till they almost reached the mountains."

scene: The rocky path. Aladdin walks slowly, exhausted, his shoulders slumped.
action: Aladdin begs to go back, but the magician leads him on.
caption: "Aladdin was so tired that he begged to go back, but the magician beguiled him."

scene: Two great mountains stand on either side of a narrow valley. The ground is barren and strange.
caption: "At last they came to two mountains divided by a narrow valley."

scene: The valley. The magician stands firm, gesturing for Aladdin to stop.
action: The magician declares they will go no farther.
caption: "We will go no farther, said the false uncle."

scene: The valley. Aladdin gathers dry sticks and branches, piling them on the ground.
caption: "Only do you gather up sticks while I kindle a fire."

scene: The valley. The magician lights the fire and throws powder upon it. He speaks strange words.
action: The magician throws powder on the fire and speaks magical words.
caption: "When it was lit the magician threw on it a powder, at the same time saying some magical words."

scene: The valley. The earth trembles and splits open. A square flat stone with a brass ring in the centre appears.
caption: "The earth trembled a little and opened, disclosing a square flat stone with a brass ring."

scene: The valley. Aladdin turns and tries to flee. The magician catches him and strikes him.
action: Aladdin tries to run away; the magician catches him and gives him a blow.
caption: "Aladdin tried to run away, but the magician caught him and gave him a blow."

scene: The valley. Aladdin lies on the ground, dazed. The magician looms over him.
caption: "What have I done, uncle? he said piteously."

scene: The valley. The magician speaks more kindly now, gesturing toward the stone.
caption: "Fear nothing, but obey me. Beneath this stone lies a treasure."

scene: The valley. The magician points down at the stone, explaining the rules.
caption: "You must do exactly as I tell you."

scene: The valley. Aladdin kneels and grasps the brass ring. His face is eager now.
action: Aladdin grasps the ring, saying the names of his father and grandfather.
caption: "At the word treasure Aladdin forgot his fears, and grasped the ring."

scene: The valley. The stone lifts easily, revealing a flight of steps descending into darkness.
caption: "The stone came up quite easily, and some steps appeared."

scene: The valley. The magician stands at the mouth of the cave, instructing Aladdin.
caption: "Go down, said the magician; at the foot of those steps you will find an open door."

scene: The valley. The magician continues his instructions, holding up a warning finger.
caption: "Tuck up your gown and go through them without touching anything, or you will die."

scene: The valley. The magician describes the garden beyond the halls.
caption: "These halls lead into a garden of fine fruit trees."

scene: The valley. The magician speaks of the lamp.
caption: "Walk on until you come to a niche in a terrace where stands a lighted lamp."

scene: The valley. The magician instructs Aladdin to pour out the oil and bring the lamp.
caption: "Pour out the oil it contains, and bring it to me."

scene: The valley. The magician draws a ring from his finger and gives it to Aladdin.
action: The magician gives Aladdin a ring.
caption: "He drew a ring from his finger and gave it to Aladdin, bidding him prosper."

scene: The cave mouth. Aladdin descends the steps into the darkness.
caption: None

scene: Three large halls stretch before Aladdin, filled with treasures and goods. The air is cool and still.
action: Aladdin tucks up his gown and walks through the halls without touching anything.
caption: "At the foot of those steps he found an open door leading into three large halls."

scene: Beyond the halls, a lush garden of fine fruit trees stretches out, laden with sparkling fruit.
caption: "The halls lead into a garden of fine fruit trees."

scene: A terrace in the garden. In a niche stands a lighted lamp, its flame steady and bright.
action: Aladdin pours out the oil from the lamp.
caption: "He came to a niche in a terrace where stood a lighted lamp."

scene: The garden. Aladdin gathers some fruit from the trees, which are in reality precious stones.
action: Aladdin gathers fruit off the trees.
caption: "He gathered some fruit off the trees, and having got the lamp, arrived at the mouth of the cave."

scene: The cave mouth. The magician waits impatiently above, peering down into the darkness.
action: The magician cries out for the lamp.
caption: "The magician cried out in a great hurry: Make haste and give me the lamp."

scene: The cave mouth. Aladdin stands just inside the darkness, the lamp clutched to his chest.
action: Aladdin refuses to give up the lamp until he is out of the cave.
caption: "This Aladdin refused to do until he was out of the cave."

scene: The cave mouth. The magician's face contorts with rage. He throws more powder on the fire.
action: The magician flies into a passion and throws powder on the fire.
caption: "The magician flew into a terrible passion, and throwing some more powder on the fire."

scene: The cave mouth. The magician speaks magical words. The great stone rolls back into place, sealing the entrance.
action: The magician says something, and the stone rolls back into place.
caption: "He said something, and the stone rolled back into its place."

scene: The cave mouth. The magician walks away into the distance, leaving the sealed stone behind.
caption: "The magician left Persia for ever."

scene: A flashback. The magician's true nature is revealed — he is no uncle, but a cunning magician who read of the lamp in his magic books.
caption: "He was no uncle of Aladdin's, but a cunning magician, who had read in his magic books."

scene: The sealed cave. Darkness presses in from all sides. Silence.
caption: "Though he alone knew where to find it, he could only receive it from the hand of another."

scene: The sealed cave. The magician's cruel plan is laid bare — he intended to kill Aladdin once he had the lamp.
caption: "He had picked out the foolish Aladdin, intending to get the lamp and kill him afterward."

scene: Complete darkness inside the sealed cave. Aladdin sits alone, weeping.
caption: "For two days Aladdin remained in the dark, crying and lamenting."

scene: The darkness. Aladdin clasps his hands together in prayer.
action: Aladdin clasps his hands in prayer, rubbing the ring on his finger.
caption: "At last he clasped his hands in prayer, and in so doing rubbed the ring."

scene: The darkness. A blinding light erupts from the ring. An enormous, frightful genie rises from the earth.
caption: "An enormous and frightful genie rose out of the earth, saying: What wouldst thou with me?"

scene: The darkness. The genie towers above Aladdin, fearsome and mighty.
caption: "I am the Slave of the Ring, and will obey thee in all things."

scene: The darkness. Aladdin stands firm despite his fear, looking up at the genie.
caption: "Aladdin fearlessly replied: Deliver me from this place!"

scene: The earth opens beneath Aladdin. Light floods in as he is lifted upward.
caption: "Whereupon the earth opened, and he found himself outside."

scene: The city street at dawn. Aladdin stands blinking in the light, disoriented and weak.
action: Aladdin walks home, his eyes adjusting to the light.
caption: "As soon as his eyes could bear the light he went home."

scene: The threshold of Aladdin's home. He collapses on the doorstep.
caption: "But he fainted on the threshold."

scene: The home. Aladdin lies on a mat, his mother kneeling beside him. He recounts his adventure.
action: Aladdin tells his mother what has passed.
caption: "When he came to himself he told his mother what had passed."

scene: The home. Aladdin shows his mother the lamp and the fruits he gathered.
action: Aladdin displays the lamp and the precious stones.
caption: "He showed her the lamp and the fruits, which were in reality precious stones."

scene: The home. Aladdin looks hungry and weary, asking for food.
caption: "He then asked for some food."

scene: The home. His mother looks around the bare room, her face filled with despair.
caption: "Alas! child, she said, I have nothing in the house."

scene: The home. His mother gestures toward a small bundle of spun cotton.
caption: "But I have spun a little cotton and will go and sell it."

scene: The home. Aladdin stops her, gesturing toward the lamp.
action: Aladdin bids his mother keep her cotton.
caption: "Aladdin bade her keep her cotton, for he would sell the lamp instead."

scene: The home. His mother picks up the dirty lamp and begins to rub it to make it presentable.
caption: "As it was very dirty she began to rub it, that it might fetch a higher price."

scene: The home. A hideous genie appears in a cloud of smoke, towering over the room.
action: The genie appears and asks what she would have.
caption: "Instantly a hideous genie appeared, and asked what she would have."

scene: The home. Aladdin's mother collapses to the floor in terror.
caption: "She fainted away."

scene: The home. Aladdin seizes the lamp from his mother's hand, standing bold before the genie.
action: Aladdin snatches the lamp and commands the genie.
caption: "Aladdin, snatching the lamp, said boldly: Fetch me something to eat!"

scene: The home. The genie returns carrying a silver bowl and twelve silver plates laden with rich meats, two silver cups, and two bottles of wine.
action: The genie returns with the feast.
caption: "The genie returned with a silver bowl, twelve silver plates containing rich meats."

scene: The home. Aladdin's mother stirs and opens her eyes, seeing the magnificent feast spread before her.
action: She comes to herself and sees the feast.
caption: "Aladdin's mother, when she came to herself, said: Whence comes this splendid feast?"

scene: The home. Aladdin gestures toward the food, smiling.
caption: "Ask not, but eat, replied Aladdin."

scene: The home. Aladdin and his mother sit eating the feast. Hours pass.
action: They sit at breakfast till it is dinner-time.
caption: "So they sat at breakfast till it was dinner-time."

scene: The home. Aladdin tells his mother about the lamp and its powers.
action: Aladdin tells his mother about the lamp.
caption: "Aladdin told his mother about the lamp."

scene: The home. His mother pleads with Aladdin, her face anxious.
action: She begs him to sell the lamp and have nothing to do with devils.
caption: "She begged him to sell it, and have nothing to do with devils."

scene: The home. Aladdin shakes his head firmly, the ring visible on his finger.
caption: "No, said Aladdin, since chance hath made us aware of its virtues, we will use it."

scene: The home. Aladdin touches the ring on his finger.
caption: "And the ring likewise, which I shall always wear on my finger."

scene: The home. The last silver plate sits on the table. Aladdin looks at it, then rubs the lamp.
caption: "When they had eaten all the genie had brought, Aladdin sold one of the silver plates."

scene: The home. The genie appears once more with a fresh set of silver plates.
caption: "He then had recourse to the genie, who gave him another set of plates."

scene: The home. Years pass. The room is now modestly furnished. Aladdin and his mother live comfortably.
caption: "Thus they lived for many years."

scene: The city streets. A herald walks through the marketplace, a scroll in his hand. People gather to listen.
caption: "One day Aladdin heard an order from the Sultan proclaimed."

scene: The marketplace. The herald reads from the scroll — everyone must stay at home and close shutters while the Princess goes to and from the bath.
caption: "Everyone was to stay at home and close his shutters while the Princess went to the bath."

scene: The streets, now empty and shuttered. Aladdin hides behind the door of the bath house, peering through a chink.
action: Aladdin hides behind the door and peeps through a chink.
caption: "He hid himself behind the door of the bath, and peeped through a chink."

scene: The bath house entrance. The Princess lifts her veil as she enters, revealing her face — radiant and beautiful.
caption: "The Princess lifted her veil as she went in, and looked so beautiful."

scene: The bath house. Aladdin stares, struck by love at first sight.
caption: "Aladdin fell in love with her at first sight."

scene: Aladdin's home. He enters, transformed — his face gaunt, his eyes distant. His mother startles at the sight of him.
action: Aladdin goes home so changed that his mother is frightened.
caption: "He went home so changed that his mother was frightened."

scene: The home. Aladdin sits on a stool, speaking earnestly to his mother.
action: Aladdin tells his mother he loves the Princess.
caption: "He told her he loved the Princess so deeply that he could not live without her."

scene: The home. Aladdin stands, his jaw set with determination.
caption: "He meant to ask her in marriage of her father."

scene: The home. His mother laughs aloud, covering her mouth in disbelief.
caption: "His mother, on hearing this, burst out laughing."

scene: The home. Aladdin pleads with his mother, his hands clasped. She finally relents.
caption: "Aladdin at last prevailed upon her to go before the Sultan and carry his request."

scene: The home. His mother takes a napkin and carefully lays in it the magic fruits from the enchanted garden.
action: She fetches a napkin and lays in it the magic fruits.
caption: "She fetched a napkin and laid in it the magic fruits from the enchanted garden."

scene: The home. The fruits sparkle and shine on the napkin, radiant as jewels.
caption: "Which sparkled and shone like the most beautiful jewels."

scene: The palace entrance. Aladdin's mother carries the napkin of treasures, walking with purpose.
action: She took these with her to please the Sultan, trusting in the lamp.
caption: "She took these with her to please the Sultan, and set out, trusting in the lamp."

scene: The Sultan's audience chamber. The Grand Vizier and lords of council are assembled before the throne.
caption: "The Grand Vizier and the lords of council had just gone in as she entered the hall."

scene: The audience chamber. Aladdin's mother stands in front of the Sultan, holding the napkin. He does not look at her.
caption: "She placed herself in front of the Sultan. He, however, took no notice of her."

scene: The audience chamber. Day after day, Aladdin's mother stands in the same place, unnoticed.
action: She went every day for a week, and stood in the same place.
caption: "She went every day for a week, and stood in the same place."

scene: The audience chamber. The council breaks up on the sixth day. The Sultan turns to his Vizier.
caption: "When the council broke up on the sixth day the Sultan said to his Vizier."

scene: The audience chamber. The Sultan gestures toward the woman standing in the hall.
caption: "I see a certain woman in the audience-chamber every day carrying something in a napkin."

scene: The audience chamber. The Sultan speaks with authority.
caption: "Call her next time, that I may find out what she wants."

scene: The audience chamber. The next day. At a sign from the Vizier, Aladdin's mother walks forward.
action: She went up to the foot of the throne.
caption: "Next day, at a sign from the Vizier, she went up to the foot of the throne."

scene: The audience chamber. Aladdin's mother kneels before the Sultan, the napkin of treasures in her hands.
caption: "She remained kneeling till the Sultan said to her: Rise, good woman, and tell me what you want."

scene: The audience chamber. Aladdin's mother stands, her head bowed, speaking carefully.
caption: "Before I tell you, I must beg your pardon for my boldness."

scene: The audience chamber. The Sultan nods, assuring her he is not angry.
caption: "The Sultan assured her he was not angry."

scene: The audience chamber. Aladdin's mother speaks of her son's love for the Princess.
caption: "So she told him of her son's violent love for the Princess."

scene: The audience chamber. Aladdin's mother kneels again, her hands clasped in supplication.
caption: "I pray you to grant his request."

scene: The audience chamber. The Sultan looks at the gift the mother has brought, his eyes wide with astonishment.
action: The Sultan looks at the gift and is astonished at its beauty.
caption: "The Sultan looked at the gift, and was astonished at its beauty."

scene: The audience chamber. The Sultan speaks his condition.
caption: "He could not think of marrying his daughter to anyone who could not bring him four trays of gold."

scene: The audience chamber. The Sultan gestures toward the palace gardens.
caption: "From the gardens of the palace."

scene: The home. Aladdin's mother tells him what the Sultan said. Aladdin's face lights up.
caption: "When she told Aladdin what the Sultan had said."

scene: The home. Aladdin rubs the lamp, summoning the genie.
action: Aladdin has recourse to the genie.
caption: "He at once had recourse to the genie."

scene: The home. The genie presents four trays of gold and precious stones, far richer than the Sultan demanded.
caption: "Who brought him four trays of gold and precious stones, far richer than the Sultan had demanded."

scene: The audience chamber. The Sultan stares at the magnificent trays, overwhelmed.
caption: "The Sultan was so overpowered with this magnificent gift."

scene: The audience chamber. The Sultan nods in agreement, smiling.
caption: "He immediately agreed to the marriage."

scene: A private chamber. The Grand Vizier stands before the Sultan, his face tight with jealousy.
caption: "The Grand Vizier, who had set his heart on the Princess marrying his son."

scene: The private chamber. The Vizier gestures suspiciously.
caption: "He told the Sultan he could not understand how anyone could bring such a treasure."

scene: The private chamber. The Sultan waves off the Vizier's concerns, unconcerned.
caption: "The Sultan did not trouble himself about this, and the wedding was fixed for a fortnight after."

scene: Aladdin's home. The day of the wedding arrives. Aladdin stands before the genie, dressed in magnificent clothes.
action: The genie dresses Aladdin in magnificent clothes.
caption: "When the day arrived, Aladdin had the genie dress him in magnificent clothes."

scene: The city streets. Aladdin rides a beautiful horse through the crowd. The Sultan's guard plays trumpets before him.
action: Aladdin rides on a beautiful horse while trumpets sound.
caption: "He rode on a beautiful horse, while the Sultan's guard went before him, playing upon trumpets."

scene: The city streets. The people flock from all sides to watch the procession, craning their necks.
caption: "The people flocked from all sides to see his splendid train."

scene: The city streets. The townspeople murmur in admiration.
caption: "Everyone admired his generosity and fine appearance."

scene: The palace gates. Aladdin arrives, dismounts, and approaches the entrance. The Princess watches from a window, delighted.
caption: "When he reached the palace, the Princess was delighted with his handsome looks."

scene: The palace gates. The Sultan watches from above, pleased.
caption: "And the Sultan with his generosity."

scene: A private chamber in the palace. The Grand Vizier's son watches through a window, his fists clenched.
caption: "But the Grand Vizier's son was overcome with envy."

scene: The throne room. Aladdin ascends to the throne and lays the trays of gold and precious stones before the Sultan.
action: Aladdin lays the trays before the Sultan.
caption: "Aladdin went up to the throne, and laid the trays of gold and precious stones before the Sultan."

scene: The palace. Aladdin takes the Princess by the hand and leads her to the bath.
action: Aladdin leads the Princess to the bath.
caption: "Then he led the Princess to the bath."

scene: The bath house. Aladdin presents the Princess with the richest of robes.
caption: "He presented her with the richest of robes."

scene: The bath house. Aladdin presents the attendants with splendid dresses.
action: He gives the attendants splendid dresses.
caption: "And to her attendants he gave such splendid dresses as made them appear like queens."

scene: The throne room. Aladdin takes the Princess by the hand and leads her to the throne.
action: Aladdin leads the Princess to the throne.
caption: "Aladdin took the Princess by the hand and led her to the throne."

scene: The throne room. The Sultan receives them with delight, raising his hand in blessing.
caption: "The Sultan received them with delight, and ordered that the marriage should take place without delay."

scene: A distant land. The African magician returns to his own country, his face twisted with rage.
caption: "In the meantime, the African magician had returned to his own country, full of rage."

scene: The magician's study. Magic books and scrolls surround him. He paces, plotting.
caption: "He was determined to get the lamp out of Aladdin's possession."

scene: The city streets near the palace. The magician carries a bundle of new lamps, crying out to passersby.
action: The magician goes to the palace crying: New lamps for old!
caption: "He took a quantity of new lamps, and went to the palace, crying: New lamps for old!"

scene: The palace. The Princess hears the noise from the window and sends a servant to investigate.
caption: "The Princess, hearing the noise, sent to see what he was offering."

scene: The palace gates. The servant speaks to the magician, who shows his new lamps.
action: The magician tells the servant he is giving new lamps for old ones.
caption: "He told her he was giving new lamps for old ones."

scene: The palace. The Princess, thinking it a good bargain, orders Aladdin's old lamp to be given to the magician.
action: She sent for Aladdin's old lamp.
caption: "The Princess, thinking it was a good bargain, sent for Aladdin's old lamp."

scene: The palace. A servant snatches the lamp from the Princess's hand before it reaches the magician.
action: The servant snatches the lamp and carries it away.
caption: "A servant snatched it from her and carried it away."

scene: The palace gates. The servant gives the old lamp to the magician and receives a new one in exchange.
action: The servant goes to the magician and gets a new lamp in exchange.
caption: "The servant then went to the magician and got a new lamp in exchange."

scene: A private spot. The magician holds the old lamp, his eyes gleaming. He rubs it.
caption: "When the magician had the lamp in his possession, he at once rubbed it."

scene: The genie appears before the magician, towering and fearsome.
caption: "And the genie appeared."

scene: The magician commands the genie, his voice commanding.
caption: "Take me and the Princess, he commanded, and set us down in some far-off country."

scene: In an instant, the palace and the Princess vanish. The Sultan's palace stands empty.
caption: "In a moment they were transported to Africa."

scene: A castle in Africa. The magician shuts the Princess up in a room, then leaves.
action: The magician shut the Princess up in his palace.
caption: "The magician shut the Princess up in his palace, and then returned to his own house."

scene: The Sultan's throne room. The Sultan learns of his daughter's disappearance. He is beside himself with grief.
caption: "When the Sultan heard of the disappearance of his daughter and son-in-law, he was beside himself with grief."

scene: The palace grounds. Aladdin returns from hunting to find the palace empty. He stares in disbelief.
caption: "Aladdin, who had been out hunting, returned to find the palace empty."

scene: The palace grounds. Aladdin falls to his knees, weeping bitterly.
action: He was so distressed that he wept bitterly.
caption: "He was so distressed that he wept bitterly."

scene: The throne room. The Sultan's guards seize Aladdin and drag him before the throne.
action: The guards seized Aladdin and dragged him before the throne.
caption: "The Sultan's guards seized him and dragged him before the throne."

scene: The throne room. The Sultan glares down at Aladdin, his face contorted with anger.
caption: "The Sultan was so angry that he would have had Aladdin killed."

scene: The throne room. The people cry out from the gallery, pleading for Aladdin's life.
caption: "But the people pleaded for him, for they loved him."

scene: The throne room. The Sultan relents, his hand raised in concession.
caption: "At last the Sultan consented to spare his life, on condition that he would bring back the Princess within forty days."

scene: The throne room. Aladdin agrees and sets out on his journey.
action: Aladdin agreed to this, and set out on his journey.
caption: "Aladdin agreed to this, and set out on his journey."

scene: A high mountain. Aladdin travels for many days and comes to a small cottage. An old woman sits inside spinning.
action: He asks her if she knows where the Princess is.
caption: "He travelled for many days, and at last came to the foot of a high mountain."

scene: The cottage. The old woman tells Aladdin she has heard the Princess is in a castle in Africa, built by the magician.
caption: "She told him that she had heard she was in a castle in Africa, built by the magician."

scene: The cottage. The old woman gives Aladdin a magic ring for protection.
action: She gave him a magic ring which would protect him from all harm.
caption: "Aladdin begged her to help him, and she gave him a magic ring."

scene: The castle in Africa. Aladdin puts on the ring and finds himself instantly inside the Princess's room.
action: He put it on his finger, and at once found himself in the palace where the Princess was.
caption: "He put it on his finger, and at once found himself in the palace where the Princess was."

scene: A room in the castle. The Princess sits alone, weeping bitterly. Her face is streaked with tears.
caption: "He found her sitting in a room, weeping bitterly."

scene: The room. The Princess sees Aladdin and leaps to her feet, her face lighting with joy.
action: She was overjoyed, and they embraced each other tenderly.
caption: "When she saw him, she was overjoyed, and they embraced each other tenderly."

scene: The room. Aladdin speaks to the Princess, his face set with determination.
caption: "Aladdin told her he would kill the magician and set her free."

scene: The room. The Princess tells Aladdin where the lamp is kept.
caption: "She told him that the magician kept the wonderful lamp in a box in his room."

scene: The magician's room. Aladdin enters and finds a box. He opens it and takes out the lamp.
